comment: source_paths, install, pytest and fail_on_skip tell scripts/ci/run_affected_suites.py how to run a suite locally; not_local says why it cannot. Every tracked test file belongs to exactly one suite, and every suite names the required checks that run it (ADR-1528). scripts/ci/suite_registry.py check enforces both; scripts/ci/suite_registry.py run tooling runs the tooling suite. docs/development/test-suites.md describes each suite.

suites.name: core
suites.not_local: Meson tests need the C build; the merge train builds it and runs the fast suite
suites.runs: Meson tests registered in core/test/meson.build and core/tools/test/meson.build; backend-gated tests run in the all-backend Linux Intel LLVM leg

suites.name: python-harness
suites.not_local: needs the gcov C build and the Cython extension of the Coverage Gate job; the merge train runs the Netflix golden gate
suites.runs: pytest python/test/ (Coverage Gate) and tox -c python (Ubuntu gcc, on C-core changes)

suites.name: vmaf-tune
suites.runs: pytest over this suite's files (suite_registry.py list vmaf-tune) with tools/vmaf-tune/requirements-dev-lock.txt

suites.name: vmaf-tune-train
suites.runs: pytest in the Tiny AI job, whose venv holds torch from ai/requirements-dev-lock.txt; vmaf-tune's dev lock leaves torch out (the train extra), so the predictor trainer test runs there; the file path wins over the vmaf-tune directory (ADR-1568)

suites.name: go
suites.not_local: needs the CPU + ONNX Runtime libvmaf build; the go vet + go test job runs it
suites.runs: go test ./... against the CPU + ONNX Runtime libvmaf build

suites.name: rust
suites.not_local: needs an installed CPU libvmaf and a cargo toolchain; the vmafx-sys CI job runs it
suites.runs: cargo test --workspace --all-features against the installed CPU libvmaf

suites.name: helm-chart
suites.not_local: needs the pinned, checksum-verified helm the helm lint + template job installs
suites.runs: unittest in the helm lint + template job, which installs the pinned, checksum-verified helm these tests render the chart with; the most specific path wins over the tooling suite's scripts/ (ADR-1568)

suites.name: ffmpeg-patches
suites.not_local: needs the FFmpeg source checkout of the FFmpeg Patch Stack job (make ffmpeg-input-contract)
suites.runs: make ffmpeg-input-contract in the FFmpeg Patch Stack job, which ffmpeg-patches/test/check_input_contract.py requires of that job (ADR-1240)

suites.name: tooling
suites.runs: scripts/ci/suite_registry.py run tooling: one pytest run over every Python test file, then every shell test file with bash
